h('4. Desired end state')
for s in [
'One dedicated Debian LXC provides the persistent GEV service and the physical kiosk. The iMac runs Proxmox, not macOS; this deployment does not install the separate native Apple spatial application.',

h('5. Host discovery gate')
p('Execution contexts are explicit: HOST means the Proxmox shell; CT ROOT means pct exec into the selected container as root; CT GEV means the non-root service account. The agent writes discovered values, shell-quoted safely, to HOST /root/gev-deploy/resolved.env (0600) and a nonsecret CT-specific subset at /etc/gev/resolved.env (0640 or narrower). No example placeholder may be executed or sent to the operator to fill in.')
p('100.98.1.114 is the management endpoint only. It lies in shared address space used by overlays as well as other networks; its digits do not establish Tailscale, the LAN, a gateway or a trust boundary. Discover routes and interfaces. Do not assign this address to the LXC, bridge an overlay interface, or allow the entire 100.64.0.0/10 range. [S6]')
code('host-preflight',r'''# HOST: capture stdout/stderr and exit status per command.

p('Also inspect the cluster/guest inventory, quorum where applicable, active backup/migration tasks, physical LAN bridge membership, DHCP/DNS conventions, storage type and free capacity, and current firewall engine/rules. Inventory existing GPU consumers and the active/free VTs. Record the Radeon PCI BDF, driver, DRM major/minor numbers, internal-panel EDID, connector properties and modes. Do not infer the present disks or filesystem from the iMac\'s factory Fusion Drive specification.')

h('6. LXC creation baseline')
p('Start unprivileged. Allocate 2 CPU cores, 6144 MiB RAM and 32 GiB rootfs on a healthy existing LXC-capable storage. Allow 2048 MiB swap only when the host actually has suitable swap; otherwise set zero and record it. Preserve at least 8 GiB of available host RAM for Proxmox/other workloads at admission, and maintain free storage for one retained release plus a backup. These are deployment budgets, not measured GEV requirements.')
p('Select a free cluster-wide CTID and recheck immediately before creation. On rerun, resume only the CT identified by this run\'s ledger and ownership marker; a matching hostname alone is insufficient. Prefer a cached supported Debian 13 amd64 template; download from the configured Proxmox template source when necessary. Debian 12 is a recorded fallback. No Docker or broad nesting is needed for the baseline.')
p('Choose a real existing trusted application/LAN bridge. Prefer DHCP with a persistent MAC; use a pre-existing reservation or an already-authorized DHCP/DNS mechanism for stability. A lease alone is not a static-address guarantee. Never infer a free static IP from ping silence. If no stable lease/DNS mechanism is available, keep the usable DHCP deployment and report the address as dynamic, rather than fabricate stability.')
code('host-create',r'''# HOST: values already resolved and recorded by the agent.
. /root/gev-deploy/resolved.env

: "${CT_MAC:?}" "${SWAP_MIB:?}"

Preserve a discovered VLAN tag where necessary. Before any non-loopback listener starts, implement and test Section 12. Set only individually justified LXC features after capturing the exact failure; do not globally disable AppArmor/seccomp or set an unconfined profile.')

p('Native dev[n] accepts a host device path and UID/GID/mode controls; PVE maps the requested container IDs through its user mapping when constructing device nodes. Use the container\'s actual video/render GIDs, not guessed host GIDs. Check the installed pct help/schema before applying options. The host owns amdgpu throughout. [S3]',comment='Retains the required native PVE LXC passthrough, adds container-ID ownership and physical-seat requirements. Render-node access alone does not establish display ownership.')
p('Install the CT packages and accounts from Sections 8 and 11.1 before finalizing GIDs. Match the primary and render devices to the same Radeon PCI identity. Use the resolved real /dev/dri/cardN and renderDN nodes in native mappings. Record any /dev/dri/by-path identities for later comparison. Never assume card0 or renderD128, and never select simpledrm merely because it is card0.')
code('host-devices',r'''# HOST: dev0/dev1 must be free or owned by this deployment.
. /root/gev-deploy/resolved.env
: "${CTID:?}" "${GPU_CARD:?}" "${GPU_RENDER:?}"
VIDEO_GID=$(pct exec "$CTID" -- getent group video | cut -d: -f3)
RENDER_GID=$(pct exec "$CTID" -- getent group render | cut -d: -f3)

pct set "$CTID" --dev0 "path=$GPU_CARD,uid=0,gid=$VIDEO_GID,mode=0660"
pct set "$CTID" --dev1 "path=$GPU_RENDER,uid=0,gid=$RENDER_GID,mode=0660"

''')
p('Physical-seat path: select an unused host VT (normally 7 or higher, but discover it), verify no existing session owns it, and reserve only that VT. Save the getty state before disabling/masking that one instance if necessary. Map /dev/tty0 and /dev/ttyN with additional free dev[n] entries, uid=0,gid=0,mode=0600. These are for Xorg, not the browser. Pass neither /dev as a directory nor all input devices. A read-only wall display requires no blanket keyboard/mouse/camera/microphone exposure.')
p('Use an explicit vtN and controlling TTY for Xorg as specified in Section 11. If the VT opens but switching requires host authority, activate only the reserved VT with host chvt and install a CT-specific, root-owned post-start hook or host service to repeat that operation at boot. Validate the installed PVE hook contract; never call pct set recursively from a running guest hook. Preserve and restore the prior VT/getty state in rollback. A -sharevts flag is not a permissions remedy. [S4]')
p('Reboot identity gate: before the kiosk starts, compare passed device major/minor numbers with sysfs and the recorded PCI BDF. If card numbering changes, fail the kiosk closed and reconcile only this stopped CT\'s mappings through the host deployment/recovery runner. Keep the GEV service available when possible. Never silently operate a different card. Do not reset/unbind the GPU or alter host firmware/kernel parameters unattended.')

h('9. GEV application deployment')
h('9.1 Node.js and accounts',2)
p('Use a currently supported Node 24.x patch that meets the selected checkout\'s engines constraint (at the audited SHA: at least 24.14.0). The local agent obtains the official linux-x64 release and verifies its published checksum and available release signature using trusted Node release-key material, or uses an existing approved signed package source providing that version. Use explicit executable paths and PATH in services; an interactive nvm installation or finding npm alone is insufficient. Verify both node and npm as the gev account.')
code('ct-accounts',r'''# CT ROOT: validate any existing accounts before reusing them.

h('9.2 Candidate checkout and checks',2)
p('Create the candidate directory as root, grant only that directory to gev, and clone origin there as gev. Set upstream if absent, fetch origin/main, resolve the candidate SHA once and check it out detached. Preserve tracked modifications in any existing deployment; never force-reset them. code('ct-candidate',r'''# CT GEV: never run dependency lifecycle scripts as root.

Capture every command\'s exit status and output. Under Node 24, GEV_REQUIRE_ALLOCATION_GATE=1 prevents an uncalibrated-runtime result from being accepted as the full allocation battery. Run repository browser/tracking tests according to their actual prerequisites and report any not run. [S2]')

Start a candidate smoke server on a free loopback-only port, explicitly set that port and --strictPort, and test UI assets and same-origin API behavior before promotion. h('11. Physical 5K kiosk display')
h('11.1 Accounts and exact display binding',2)
p('Use the accounts created in Section 9.1. Xorg alone may run as CT root for direct DRM/VT ownership. gevdisplay owns only its persistent Chromium profile and session runtime directory; it does not read /etc/gev/gev.env or inherit the service\'s credentials. Record the actual Xorg and Chromium executable paths.')
p('Use the Xorg modesetting driver with the selected kmsdev and glamor acceleration. This is a userspace Xorg choice; the kernel driver is still amdgpu. If the packaged AMD DDX is required by a demonstrated hardware issue, bind it by the verified PCI BusID and keep the same acceptance tests. [S4]')
code('ct-xorg-config',r'''# CT ROOT: GPU_CARD is the actual passed primary node inside this CT.
. /etc/gev/resolved.env
: "${GPU_CARD:?}"
install -d -m 0755 /etc/X11/xorg.conf.d
cat > /etc/X11/xorg.conf.d/20-gev-gpu.conf <<EOF
Section "Device"
  Identifier "GEV Radeon"
  Driver "modesetting"
  Option "kmsdev" "$GPU_CARD"
  Option "AccelMethod" "glamor"
EndSection
Section "ServerFlags"
  Option "AutoAddDevices" "false"
  Option "AllowMouseOpenFail" "true"
EndSection
EOF
''')
p('AutoAddDevices=false is for the output-only kiosk. Add explicitly identified input hardware only when an input task is authorized; never turn display work into general sensor access. After Xorg starts, match the XRandR output(s) to the internal panel\'s EDID/DRM identity. Do not simply select the first connected output or assume an eDP name. If the panel is exposed as tiled outputs, configure the advertised tile group as one panel; do not discard half of it.')
h('11.2 X authority and controlling VT',2)
p('Save the following CT ROOT script as /usr/local/sbin/gev-xauth-prepare, mode 0755, root-owned. It creates a new cookie for each Xorg start; /run is recreated after every CT boot.')
code('gev-xauth-prepare',r'''#!/bin/sh
set -eu
umask 077
install -d -m 0750 -o root -g gevdisplay /run/gev-x11
rm -f /run/gev-x11/Xauthority
xauth -f /run/gev-x11/Xauthority add :0 . "$(mcookie)"
chown root:gevdisplay /run/gev-x11/Xauthority
chmod 0640 /run/gev-x11/Xauthority
''')
p('Generate the Xorg unit with the selected physical VT number, not an unresolved systemd variable. /usr/lib/xorg/Xorg must be verified present; substitute its discovered absolute path if different. Run only one owner for this physical panel. Omit -sharevts; explicit seat/VT ownership replaces it. [S4]')
code('ct-xorg-unit',r'''# CT ROOT: GEV_VT is the reserved HOST VT, passed into this CT.
. /etc/gev/resolved.env
: "${GEV_VT:?}"
case "$GEV_VT" in ''|*[!0-9]*) exit 1;; esac
cat > /etc/systemd/system/gev-xorg.service <<EOF
[Unit]
Description=GEV physical Xorg server
After=local-fs.target
StartLimitIntervalSec=300
StartLimitBurst=4
[Service]
Type=exec
ExecStartPre=/usr/local/sbin/gev-xauth-prepare
ExecStart=/usr/lib/xorg/Xorg :0 vt${GEV_VT} -keeptty \\
  -nolisten tcp -noreset -auth /run/gev-x11/Xauthority
StandardInput=tty
TTYPath=/dev/tty${GEV_VT}
TTYReset=yes
Restart=always
RestartSec=15
TimeoutStopSec=30
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
''')
p('If this reports a VT ioctl, DRM-master or capability failure in an unprivileged user namespace, capture the exact failure, check host ownership and the narrow mappings, then use Section 14\'s bounded fallback. Merely mapping device files does not grant every global-kernel/seat operation. Do not blank all VTs, disable the AMD driver or expand all capabilities to hide the error.')
h('11.3 Output selection and kiosk launcher',2)
p('The local agent writes /usr/local/bin/gev-display-mode as a root-owned 0755 script containing only the discovered internal output(s), mode(s), layout and any validated scale setting. It must reject missing/mismatched outputs and return a nonzero status on failed mode application. Use advertised modes; prefer 5120x2880 when exposed as the complete panel. A lower-mode fallback is a visible deviation. This avoids an unsafe generic first-output command.')
p('Save this session script as /usr/local/bin/gev-kiosk-session, mode 0755, root-owned. The real browser is not headless and must retain its sandbox.')
code('gev-kiosk-session',r'''#!/bin/sh
set -eu
ready=0
i=0
while [ "$i" -lt 60 ]; do
  if xdpyinfo >/dev/null 2>&1 && \
     curl -fsS --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:4173/ >/dev/null; then
    ready=1
    break
  fi
  i=$((i + 1))
  sleep 2
done
[ "$ready" -eq 1 ] || exit 1
/usr/local/bin/gev-display-mode
xset s off
xset s noblank
if ! xset -dpms; then
  echo 'DPMS disable unavailable; inspect and record extension state.' >&2
fi
openbox --sm-disable &
unclutter -idle 0.5 -root &
exec /usr/bin/chromium --kiosk --no-first-run \
  --ozone-platform=x11 \
  --user-data-dir=/home/gevdisplay/gev-profile \
  http://127.0.0.1:4173/
''')

Its authenticated X probe and retrying launcher handle X cookie replacement. Type=exec is not itself proof that X or HTTP is ready. The corrected path is tested for clean browser exit, X failure and backend outage.')

StartLimitIntervalSec=600

[Service]
Type=exec

SupplementaryGroups=video render

Environment=DISPLAY=:0

p('Implement a CT-local health timer at 30-second intervals: check only the GEV loopback service, the authenticated X session and the kiosk cgroup. Require three consecutive failures before remedial action. Restart only the failed component, at most three health-initiated retries per component in 15 minutes; then retain evidence and mark it failed. Do not mistake an upstream feed outage for a dead local server. After a detected backend outage recovers, restart/reload the kiosk once so it does not remain on a Chromium error page. Never restart the whole CT or Proxmox from this health timer.')
p('The timer must honor /var/lib/gev-control/maintenance and /var/lib/gev-control/kiosk-disabled markers so planned upgrades and intentional display shutdown are not undone. Limit any systemctl calls to this deployment\'s units. Persist health counters/state and rotate logs. Validate the generated timer and script; this is required implementation work for the local agent, not a claim that a health service already exists.')
p('Enable gev-access, gev, gev-xorg, gev-kiosk and the health timer only after their files pass syntax checks. Prove recovery from browser clean exit, browser crash, Xorg restart, GEV restart and CT stop/start. The application must remain usable when only the display stack is stopped.')

h('12. Network and exposure rules')
p('A working access boundary is mandatory, not conditional on whether a firewall happens to be enabled. Discover the actual approved private LAN/VLAN and, where available, narrower operator workstation addresses from existing site configuration. Prefer the existing PVE firewall if it already enforces CT rules at all required levels. Set the CT NIC firewall flag and verify its effective policy; do not enable/redesign a host-wide firewall remotely just for this job. [S1]')
p('If no existing PVE rule path is active, install a guest-local nftables inet input policy in this dedicated CT. Manage only a GEV-owned table with atomic updates; preserve unrelated rules. Permit loopback, established/related replies, required DHCP and essential ICMP/IPv6 control traffic, and TCP/4173 only from the verified allowed sources. Other unsolicited inbound traffic is denied. Handle IPv4 and IPv6 explicitly; do not leave an IPv6 listener outside the rule set. No guest SSH port is required when administration uses pct exec.')
p('Implement /etc/systemd/system/gev-access.service as a root-owned Type=oneshot, RemainAfterExit=yes gate, enabled for boot and ordered before gev.service. Its ExecStart must install/verify the selected effective access policy and return nonzero if it cannot. Validate generated nft input with nft -c before commit. It must not flush the host or guest-wide ruleset and must not remove protection when stopped. A failed gate leaves GEV loopback-only or stopped; it must never produce a briefly unprotected all-interface listener.')
p('Verify allowed access from a separate trusted LAN browser and a negative access test from a non-allowed source where available. Host-to-guest curl alone does not prove access from the management overlay. Record the actual guest URL; do not advertise 100.98.1.114:4173 unless an independently configured and tested forwarding service actually exists.
